meta.title: Dossier 0.7.3
meta.lede: The reader redesigned: neutral surfaces in both themes, color with three jobs, numbers on one axis, and an example browser worth sending. Every gate passed, and the call is ship.

parts.markdown: 0.7.3 changes how every page looks and reads, not what a model says or how the commands behave. Models from 0.7.0 on build unchanged, and `meta.emphasis` is accepted with no visual effect.

parts.title: Changes
rows: Neutral gray in both themes from one stylesheet of light-dark() pairs. The theme follows the system until the reader chooses light or dark.
The kind names the document, tones name status and evidence, and a decision turns its number, table row, and rail dot one color. No decorative stripes, no italic title emphasis.
Sections and items share one number axis. Items are a hairline list whose open item lifts onto paper, and hairlines, hover fills, and open cards share one outer edge.
Sections, a disclosure for the item index, and Your decisions with a dot map, Next undecided, and Copy reply. It folds above the column at compact widths.
Highlighted code uses the theme's tokens: violet keywords, teal strings, amber numbers, blue names, muted comments, and diff lines on the teal and risk fills.
Two and three hyphens stay as typed instead of becoming en and em dashes.
Tabs for the six examples with number keys, desktop, tablet, and phone widths, a theme switch that reaches into the page, and a link to the document on its own.
Rewritten around the new interface with a logo, a link to the live examples, and every image recaptured from this build.

items.title: Go checks
items.summary: Formatting, vet, staticcheck, errcheck, the race-enabled tests, and a CGO-free build all passed.

facets.label: How checked
facets.markdown: `make check` in `core`, which also drift-checks generated code and the vendored Graphviz.

facets.label: Result
facets.markdown: Every package passed. The reader is 20,472 bytes of its 20,480 byte budget and the stylesheet 31,468 of 32,768, a budget raised from 30,720 for the highlight palette and the aligned rows.

items.title: Showcase fixtures
items.summary: All seven example documents build with no warnings and match their HTML and Markdown goldens.

facets.label: How checked
facets.markdown: `TestExamples` and `TestExampleReplies` build the showcase the way a reader gets it and paste a reply into each decision document.

facets.label: Result
facets.markdown: Seven documents, six kinds, no warnings, and the largest page at 115 KB of its 120 KB budget.

items.title: 0.6 imports
items.summary: All 17 legacy fixtures upgrade to models that pass the strict 0.7 checks.

facets.label: How checked
facets.markdown: `TestLegacyFixtures` upgrades each 0.6 document and compares it with its golden.

facets.label: Result
facets.markdown: 17 of 17 upgrade strictly onto their kinds' vocabularies.

items.title: React package tests
items.summary: The wrapper renders through the binary, the reader agrees with Go on every shared reply case, and the theme follows the system until chosen.

facets.label: How checked
facets.markdown: `npm test` in `packages/react`, including the 15 reply cases shared with the Go parser and the reader's theme choice.

items.title: Visual review
items.summary: Every example was read in light and dark at desktop, tablet, and phone widths, and the README images were recaptured from this build.

facets.label: How checked
facets.markdown: Headless Chrome captures of each page at 1280, 820, and 390 pixels in both themes, with items open, decisions made, and the print stylesheet, then the capture toolkit in `docs/assets/readme/capture`.

facets.label: Result
facets.markdown: Hairlines, hover fills, and open cards share one edge, selects keep room beside their chevron, and all 25 README images show this release.

items.title: Distribution dry run
items.summary: Six archives, their checksums, the Homebrew formula, and seven npm packages build and install.

facets.label: How checked
facets.markdown: `make dist-check` cross-compiles every target, runs the formula's test commands on an archive, and installs the npm packages from tarballs.

facets.label: Result
facets.markdown: Every check printed ok, and the binary and the launcher both report 0.7.3.

parts.markdown: 0.7.3 changes only how pages look, so 0.7.2 builds the same models and the same decisions. Pages built by 0.7.2 keep the earlier look.
